newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber slightly up at close, deals thin.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber slightly up at close, deals thin.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices ended slightly higher after moving in a tight range for the greater part of the week, with a slight rebound in Tokyo helping sentiment, dealers said.

They said dealings were scattered as foreign consumers were still out of the market. "Demand is expected to be thin as buyers are waiting for attractive prices," a dealer said, adding that there were selective enquiries from several Europeans and China parties for sheet and SMR rubber.
"But they were just checking the prices," the trader added.
